You can follow the format [product name - product description] to tell creators about the basics of your brand or product. Length limit: 120 characters. Example: `CapCut - video editor` Note: If you are updating an existing campaign (with `campaign_id` specified in the request), the current campaign `campaign_name` value will be used regardless of the value you pass in. |
| `campaign_description` | `campaign_description` | `string` | No | No | Campaign description. Provide relevant information about your campaign, such as your product's positioning, target audiences, and core features. Length limit: 1,000 characters. Note: If you are updating an existing campaign (with `campaign_id` specified in the request), the current campaign `campaign_description` value will be used regardless of the value you pass in. |
| `anchor_id` | `anchor_id` | `string` | No | No | ID of the anchor to associate with the campaign. Anchors are links you add to your post that help viewers learn more about your product or service. The anchor is only visible to audiences in the anchor’s target country. Performance data of the anchor can only be measured when the creator's country matches the anchor’s target country. The video is still visible to the creator's audience, but the anchor attached is only visible to audiences in the anchor's country. To obtain the anchors within your TTO Creator Marketplace account, use [/tto/tcm/anchor/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1826564965840066). |

When a creator's video is linked to the campaign, these ad accounts will automatically be granted Spark Ads authorization for the video and the video will be automatically synced to the creative library of these ad accounts. When you specify `advertiser_ids`, `default_spark_ads_requested_authorization_days` is required. Max size: 50. To obtain the IDs of the ad accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/oauth2/advertiser/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738455508553729). |
| `default_spark_ads_requested_authorization_days` | `default_spark_ads_requested_authorization_days` | `number` | No | No | Valid when you are creating a new campaign.Required when `advertiser_ids` is specified.Optional when `advertiser_ids` is not specified.Ignored when you are updating an existing campaign. The default number of authorization days you want to request from the creator to boost all of the videos uploaded for the campaign as Spark Ads. Value range: 0-365. Default value: 0. Once this field is set to a value other than the value 0, when a creator accepts the invitation and uploads videos to the campaign, the creator automatically grants you Spark Ads authorization for the videos for the specified number of days. |
| `handle_names` | `handle_names` | `Array<string>` | Yes | No | The handle name list of TikTok creators that you want to invite to the campaign. Max size: 100. For new campaigns, specify the handle names of TikTok Creators to invite. For existing campaigns, specify additional handle names to invite. The new Creators will be added to the existing list. For example, if you created a campaign with `handle_names` as `["&#123;&#123;handle_name_1&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_2&#125;&#125;"]` and want to invite two more creators, you can pass `campaign_id` and set `handle_names` to `["&#123;&#123;handle_name_3&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_4&#125;&#125;"]`. The `handle_names` value of the updated campaign will be `["&#123;&#123;handle_name_1&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_2&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_3&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_4&#125;&#125;"]`. |
| `send_notification` | `send_notification` | `boolean` | No | No | Whether to send a notification regarding the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign invitation to the inboxes of invited TikTok creators (`handle_names`). The creators can open the notification to join the campaign. Supported values: `true`,`false`. Default value: `false`. |
| `campaign_id` | `campaign_id` | `string` | No | No | Valid when you are updating an existing campaign. If this field is passed, all the other fields except `tto_tcm_account_id` and `handle_names` will be ignored. The ID of an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. When you pass this field, you need to pass `handle_names` simultaneously to add new Creators to an existing campaign. |
| `business_account_handle` | `business_account_handle` | `string` | No | No | The handle (username) of the Business Account. When you include this parameter during campaign creation, the creator will have the option to message the brand directly when they open the generated invite link (invite_link). Only applicable when the handle is a non-EU Business Account.Note: Associating a Business Account with a TTO Creator Marketplace Campaign during campaign creation is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. |

For example, if you created a campaign with `handle_names` as `["&#123;&#123;handle_name_1&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_2&#125;&#125;"]` and want to invite two more creators, you can pass `campaign_id` and set `handle_names` to `["&#123;&#123;handle_name_3&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_4&#125;&#125;"]`. The `handle_names` value of the updated campaign will be `["&#123;&#123;handle_name_1&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_2&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_3&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;handle_name_4&#125;&#125;"]`. |

For example, if you created a campaign with `advertiser_ids` as `["&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_1&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_2&#125;&#125;"]` and want to invite two more creators, you can set `advertiser_ids` to `["&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_3&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_4&#125;&#125;"]`. The `advertiser_ids` value of the updated campaign will be `["&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_1&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_2&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_3&#125;&#125;","&#123;&#123;advertiser_id_4&#125;&#125;"]`. |

## TtoTcmRankResponseCreators

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ranking_change` | `ranking_change` | `string` | No | No | The change in rank position for the creator compared to the rank in the last time period. A positive `rank_change` indicates an increase in rank. For example, if the rank position shifts from 5 to 1, `rank_change` will be `+4`.A negative `rank_change` indicates a decrease in rank. For example, if the rank position shifts from 1 to 5, `rank_change` will be `-4`.A `rank_change` of `0` indicates no changes in rank. A `rank_change` marked as `N/A` indicates that the creator was not present in the top ranking list in the last time period. |
| `profile_image` | `profile_image` | `string` | No | No | The temporary URL for the profile image of the creator, which needs to be re-acquired after expiration. The expiration time is included in the URL after the `x-expires` parameter, in the format of an Epoch/Unix timestamp in seconds. Example: `https://p16-sign.tiktokcdn-us.com/obj/tos-useast5-avt-0123-tx/ab123456789d1234567ab54de76f0d3b?lk3s=429d27ce&nonce=42773&refresh_token=123a4ab1234567a1aa1a11a1aa11aa1a&x-expires=1732046400&x-signature=aa1Q11aa1Da1a1aVZO%1Fa1oADaL1%1D&shp=111d11ce&shcp=-`. |
| `country` | `country` | `string` | No | No | The code of the country or region where the creator is located. Currently, the only supported enum value is `US` because the creator ranking data is only available for the United States. |
| `handle` | `handle` | `string` | No | No | The handle name of the creator. |
| `display_name` | `display_name` | `string` | No | No | The display name of the creator. |
| `industry_labels` | `industry_labels` | `Array<TtoTcmRankResponseCreatorsIndustryLabels>` | No | No | The list of industry labels associated with the creator. Creator industry labels are assigned to creators based on the commercial content they produce, including ad creatives and branded content on their TikTok accounts, and represent their commercial experience in certain industries. Note: Creators who no longer have the queried label may still be returned in the results. This is because the label was associated with them at the time the rank was generated. However, these labels can change over time, so a creator might lose a label after the rank has been generated. |
| `content_labels` | `content_labels` | `Array<TtoTcmRankResponseCreatorsContentLabels>` | No | No | The list of content tag labels associated with the creator. Content tag labels are assigned to creators based on the main focus of the creator’s TikTok account, and represent the direction of the creator’s organic content. Note: Creators who no longer have the queried label may still be returned in the results. This is because the label was associated with them at the time the rank was generated. However, these labels can change over time, so a creator might lose a label after the rank has been generated. |
| `score` | `score` | `number` | No | No | When `ranking_type` is `BRANDED_CONTENT`, this field represents commercial score, which is calculated based on the creator’s experience with commercial content with and the performance of their past commercial content.When `ranking_type` is `ORGANIC_CONTENT`, this field represents follower growth score (an indicator of how quickly the creator’s follower count is growing), which is calculated based on the creator’s follower count growth and video performance within the specified time period. Example: 81.56906666666666. |
| `number_of_followers` | `number_of_followers` | `number` | No | No | Follower count. The creator’s current follower count. Example: 242703. |
| `branded_content_video_views` | `branded_content_video_views` | `number` | No | No | Branded content video views. The total views of all branded content videos, where the video’s branded content toggle was enabled, produced by the Creator within the specified time period. Example: 528377. Note: This field returns a non-null value only when `ranking_type` is `BRANDED_CONTENT` in the request. |
| `branded_content_engagement_rate` | `branded_content_engagement_rate` | `number` | No | No | Branded content engagement rate. The engagement rate of branded content within the specified time period, calculated as (total number of comments, likes, and shares of branded content) / (total video views). For example, a value of 3.02 means the branded content engagement rate is 3.02%. Note: This field returns a non-null value only when `ranking_type` is `BRANDED_CONTENT` in the request. |
| `total_video_views` | `total_video_views` | `number` | No | No | Total video views. The total number of views from all of the creator’s videos within the specified time period. Example: 633516. |
| `engagement_rate` | `engagement_rate` | `number` | No | No | Engagement rate. The collective engagement rate for all of the creator’s videos during the specified time period. This is calculated as (total number of comments, likes and shares)/(total video views). For example, a value of 2.97 means the branded content engagement rate is 2.97%. |
| `starting_price` | `starting_price` | `number` | No | No | The creator’s starting base price. Example: 30000. Note: If the creator’s starting base pay is not set, the value of this field will be null. |
| `starting_price_currency` | `starting_price_currency` | `string` | No | No | The currency for the creator’s starting base price. Example: `USD`. Note: If the creator’s starting base pay is not set, the value of this field will be an empty string (`""`). |
| `follower_growth` | `follower_growth` | `number` | No | No | The number of followers gained during the specified time period. Example: 180476. Note: This field returns a non-null value only when `ranking_type` is `ORGANIC_CONTENT` in the request. |

## TtoTcmReportParams

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tto_tcm_account_id` | `tto_tcm_account_id` | `string` | Yes | No | The ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). |
| `campaign_id` | `campaign_id` | `string` | Yes | No | The ID of a TikTok One Creator Marketplace campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link) or [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link). To create a campaign and obtain the campaign ID, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693549459458). |
| `start_date` | `start_date` | `string` | No | No | Required when `end_date` is passed. If you specify both `start_date` and `end_date`, the response will include the `daily_stats` parameter that shows the daily metrics for the specified time range.If you don't specify both `start_date` and `end_date`, the response will not include the daily metrics (`daily_stats`). Report start date, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time). The `start_date` should not be earlier than the campaign creation time. To obtain the campaign creation time, check the `create_time` returned from [/tto/tcm/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693549459458) or [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258). Example: `2024-01-01`. |
| `end_date` | `end_date` | `string` | No | No | Required when `start_date` is passed. If you specify both `start_date` and `end_date`, the response will include the `daily_stats` parameter that shows the daily metrics for the specified time range.If you don't specify both `start_date` and `end_date`, the response will not include the daily metrics (`daily_stats`). Report end date, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time). Example: `2024-02-01`. |
| `page` | `page` | `number` | No | No | Current page number. This field specifies which page of results to retrieve. The number of pages is based on the total number of records and the `page_size`. Default value: 1. Value range: ≥ 1. |
| `page_size` | `page_size` | `number` | No | No | Page size. This specifies the number of records (the performance metrics for videos linked to the specified campaign ID) that you try to retrieve for each request. Default value: 25. Value range: 1-100. |
